basic_report: ASL was acquired on a 3T Siemens Prisma_fit scanner. Single-PLD PCASL labeling was performed with a 3D GRASE readout. The labeling duration was 1800ms, followed by a PLD of 2000ms. Background suppression was applied using 4 pulses, with pulses at 2290ms, 2925ms, 3425ms, and 3705ms after the start of labeling. Images were acquired with TR/TE = 4950ms/13.28ms, an in-plane resolution of 3.4x3.4mm^2, 20 slices, a slice thickness of 4mm, and a flip angle of 130 degrees. In total, 8 control-label pairs were acquired. M0 was acquired with the same readout and without background suppression. TR for M0 is 4950ms.
